name: Amanatides and Woo Variation with 2-Point Input
definition: A voxel traversal algorithm that takes two points (start and end) instead of a ray origin and direction. It is designed to be more precise than face-to-face traversal, handling edge cases like zero coordinate deltas, exact edge hits, negative traversal, and non-0-based block centers.
summary: This method traverses a voxel grid using two explicit 3D points instead of a ray, offering higher precision for edge cases like zero deltas or exact hits.
